15	```vb
16	Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
17	Option Explicit
18	
19	' ============================================================
20	' Analytics.bas
21	'
22	' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
23	' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
24	' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
25	' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
26	' table can never drift apart.
27	'
28	'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
29	'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
30	'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
31	'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
32	'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
33	'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
34	'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
35	'
36	' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
37	' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
38	' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
39	' ============================================================
40	
41	Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"
42	
43	' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
44	' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
45	' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
46	Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
47	    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
48	End Function

50	' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
51	' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
52	Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
53	    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
54	End Function
55	
56	' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
57	' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
58	' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
59	' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
60	Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
61	    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
62	    For i = 2 To n
63	        tmp = vals(i)
64	        j = i - 1
65	        Do While j >= 1
66	            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
67	            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
68	            j = j - 1
69	        Loop
70	        vals(j + 1) = tmp
71	    Next i
72	End Sub
73	
74	Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
75	    If n = 0 Then
76	        MedianOfArray = 0
77	        Exit Function
78	    End If
79	    SortDoubleArray vals, n
80	    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
81	        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
82	    Else
83	        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
84	    End If
85	End Function
86	
87	Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
88	    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
89	End Function
90	
91	' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
92	Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
93	    If hrs <= 24 Then
94	        TurnaroundBucket = 1
95	    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
96	        TurnaroundBucket = 2
97	    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
98	        TurnaroundBucket = 3
99	    Else
100	        TurnaroundBucket = 4
101	    End If
102	End Function
103	
104	' 1 = 14+ days, 2 = 7-14 days, 3 = 1-7 days, 4 = same day or after.
105	' leadDays = whole days from 1st CCF Creation Date-Time to Admission Date
106	' (Admission Date's DateValue minus the CCF's DateValue) -- positive means
107	' the CCF was created ahead of admission.
108	Private Function LeadDayBucket(leadDays As Long) As Long

112	        LeadDayBucket = 2
113	    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
114	        LeadDayBucket = 3
115	    Else
116	        LeadDayBucket = 4
117	    End If
118	End Function

**Interfaces:**

- Produces: `Public Sub BuildAnalyticsSheet(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, pocCol As Long, admDateCol As Long, firstCCFDtCol As Long, latestCCFDtCol As Long)` -- writes all four visible blocks and their four charts onto `ws`. Consumed by `BuildOutputWorkbook` (Task 8), which also gains a `priArr()` capture and the three new column lookups.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the module header, constants, and small numeric helpers**

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
' table can never drift apart.
'
'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'
' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"

' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
End Function

' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
End Function

' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
    For i = 2 To n
        tmp = vals(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 1
            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        vals(j + 1) = tmp
    Next i
End Sub

Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
    If n = 0 Then
        MedianOfArray = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    SortDoubleArray vals, n
    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
    Else
        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
    End If
End Function

Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
End Function

' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
    If hrs <= 24 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 1
    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 2
    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 3
    Else
        TurnaroundBucket = 4
    End If
End Function

    If leadDays >= 14 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 1
    ElseIf leadDays >= 7 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 2
    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 3
    Else
        LeadDayBucket = 4
    End If
```
